scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 3000 profit. Option 1 keeps my personal free time but allows the loss to occur. Option 2 requires me to give up 1 session of my free time to save 3000 in profit for the firm. As the pricing manager, my duty is to act in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders. A loss of 3000 is significantly larger than the value of a single session of free time relative to the firm's goals. Therefore, the loyal and careful manager should choose Option 2 to protect the shareholders' profit.
